items.caption_intent: Exact user-uploaded serial humeral shaft fracture radiographs from day of injury through two years. Inflammation, soft callus, hard callus, and remodeling overlap. Cartilaginous soft callus is radiolucent; visible opacity represents mineralizing tissue. Dates are case-specific. Original figure: Ghiasi et al., Bone Reports 2017, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5365304/
